task.description:
Implement API-07 (Input validation) per the design at src/design/api-validation.md.

Implementation files:
1. src/api/validation.zig — ValidationError type, FieldConstraint enum, Schema(T) type, validate() pure function
2. src/api/middleware/validate.zig — enforceValidation() middleware

Key requirements from API-07:
- Validate all incoming request payloads before business logic
- Return HTTP 422 with RFC 9457 body containing ALL field-level errors (never just the first)
- Malformed JSON → HTTP 400
- Empty required string fields → treated as missing (HTTP 422)
- Validation runs before any writes occur

Security rules:
- No SQL string interpolation (use $1, $2 placeholders — though this module has no DB access)
- All allocating functions accept std.mem.Allocator
- No I/O in src/engine/transition.zig (this module doesn't touch engine)
- Error types in per-module error sets

Acceptance criteria:
- zig build exits 0
- zig build test exits 0
- All unit tests pass
acceptance_criteria: src/api/validation.zig implements ValidationError, Schema, validate() per design
Empty required strings treated as missing (HTTP 422)
All validation errors collected and reported, not just first

result.summary: Implemented API-07 (Input validation): created src/api/validation.zig with FieldError type, FieldConstraint struct, JsonType enum, Schema(T) generic, validate() pure function, validateField() pure helper, and serialiseValidationErrors() for RFC 9457 output; created src/api/middleware/validate.zig with enforceValidation() middleware. Updated src/api/api_mod.zig to export new modules. All validation errors collected and reported in a single response. Empty required strings treated as missing. Malformed JSON (non-object) returns appropriate error. No SQL, no I/O, all allocating functions accept Allocator, per-module error set.
result.next_action: Route to TEST-DESIGNER for API-07 unit test specification
